name: André Franqueira Rodrigues - § 16 - Am 2
title: REPORT on the fisheries management approaches for safeguarding sensitive species, tackling invasive species and benefiting local economies
part_text: 16. Calls on the Commission and the Member States to assess regional and local population size, the status and trends of species and the potential impacts that overfishing and unbalanced fish populations can have on sensitive species such as whales and dolphins, and on the viability of fishing activities, to ensure ecosystem-based management of fisheries, including measures to protect sensitive species;
